title: Applicability of Algorithm 1 to MiMC-N/N Beyond N=35
summary: The method is verified for odd block sizes from 5 through 35 and shows an empirical extra zero-sum round; whether it applies to larger odd MiMC-N/N sizes remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For the $rKR=1$ univariate key-recovery Algorithm 1 for MiMC-N/N, the method has been verified for odd block sizes $N$ from $5$ through $35$ and empirically succeeds with one more zero-sum round than the theoretical expectation; however, its behavior for larger odd $N$ has not been proved. The unresolved question is whether Algorithm 1 can be applied to MiMC-N/N for odd integers $N>35$.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of MiMC via a univariate key-recovery attack.
parameters: N: odd block size, verified from 5 through 35 and unresolved above 35
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether Algorithm 1 can be applied to MiMC-N/N for odd integers N>35.

citations.label: An Algebraic Attack on Ciphers with Low-Degree Round Functions: Application to Full MiMC

progress.summary: The source reports verification for odd block sizes 5 through 35 and an empirical extra zero-sum round beyond the theoretical expectation. It then explicitly leaves applicability to odd N>35 as an open question because the behavior for larger values has not been proved.
